actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

latest_action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
policy_area: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
title_official: A joint resolution expressing the sense of Congress that the article of amendment commonly known as the "Equal Rights Amendment" has been validly ratified and is enforceable as the 28th Amendment to the Constitution of the United States, and the Archivist of the United States must certify and publish the Equal Rights Amendment as the 28th Amendment without delay.
